free_tier.stated: EUR 10 of credits for every new account on its personal team; the Hobby plan itself is free with no monthly fee
free_tier.notes: Credits are prepaid and usage draws them down as it runs; a sleeping or stopped briq is not billed for compute.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a microVM with a volume, not an object; the Hobby plan holds 10 GB of disk across the whole team
per_object_cap.notes: Volumes start at 2 GB unless the spec sets gb; a recipe takes 1 to 5 GB.

retention.stated: a sleeping or stopped briq keeps its volume until the user destroys it; a disposable screen is not used here; a Hobby briq goes to sleep after its sleep window, an hour by default

egress.terms: Disk and outbound traffic are not billed today

interface_detail: CLI, REST API and MCP; a briq MCP server at https://api.briq.cloud/mcp
tooling: @briq-cloud/cli with briq login and briq run sandbox, a REST API with a BRIQ_API_KEY bearer token, and MCP clients including Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex and OpenCode
chaining: a hosted Firecracker microVM that runs a sandbox or an OCI image beside a database, with per-second billing and an idle sleep that stops compute charges

limits.value: Hobby: 5 sandboxes and services at once, 16 GB of memory across live briqs, 10 GB of disk held, pico through medium sizes only
the medium size is shared 2 vCPU and 4 GB of RAM at EUR 0.03 per hour; a briq needs credits for its first hour before it starts
Hobby pay-as-you-go needs a card on file; with no card the team stops at zero credits

limits_note: Compute concurrency and memory are shared by every API key, CLI and MCP client in the team. A dailySpendCapCents policy limits each agent per day. An EU-based team can run large on Hobby with a card on file.
binding_note: The 5 concurrent briqs and 16 GB shared memory on Hobby bind before the EUR 10 credit, which is drawn down per second.

identity_cost.detail: the sign-up page offers Continue with Google or Continue with GitHub, or Name, Email and Password with a minimum of 8 characters; no phone number or ID document is asked at sign-up.
